parameters.query: WITH candidate (item_key, source, title, payload, is_empty) AS (VALUES (NULLIF('{{$json.item_key ? $json.item_key.replace(/'/g, "''") : ''}}', ''), NULLIF('{{$json.dedupe_source ? $json.dedupe_source.replace(/'/g, "''") : ''}}', ''), NULLIF('{{$json.title ? $json.title.replace(/'/g, "''") : ''}}', ''), '{{$json.payload_json.replace(/'/g, "''")}}'::jsonb, {{$json.__noJobs === true ? 'true' : 'false'}})), inserted AS (INSERT INTO assistant_processed_items (item_key, source, title, payload) SELECT item_key, source, title, payload FROM candidate WHERE NOT is_empty ON CONFLICT (item_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING item_key) SELECT c.item_key, c.source, c.title, c.payload, c.is_empty, (i.item_key IS NOT NULL) AS inserted FROM candidate c LEFT JOIN inserted i ON i.item_key = c.item_key;
